summary: Vista Energy filed a Form 6-K reporting the repurchase of 50,000 Series A shares on August 4, 2026, at MXN 1,141.40 per share, totaling approximately MXN 57.07 million excluding fees. The buyback was authorized at the April 28, 2026 ordinary shareholders' meeting. Following the repurchase, 111,017,402 Series A shares remain outstanding, with 1,284,351 shares held in treasury. Citigroup's Mexican brokerage, Citi México Casa de Bolsa, executed the trades. This ongoing issuer repurchase reduces share count and returns capital to shareholders. Watch for continuation of buybacks under the standing authorization and potential support for the share price.
